Dyslexia Reading Game is specially prepared for students with dyslexia and aims to produce multiple solutions to their reading problems. Reading strategies in the app designed from easy to difficult, from simple to complex and from concrete to abstract.

Dyslexia Reading Game aims to develop four skills of dyslexic students. These are: reading fluency, reading motivation, eye line tracking and self-regulation.

Dyslexia Reading Game includes 72 original reading texts prepared according to the readability form of English. These texts have been prepared by considering six difficulty criteria. These criteria are:
1. Number of words in the text
2. Number of sentences in the text
3. Number of words in the sentence
4. Number of syllables in the word
5. Number of sounds in a syllable
6. The number of difficult words.
Reading texts in Dyslexia Reading Game are getting harder and harder. It has been adjusted so that the difficulty of the transition between texts is not felt so that the dyslexic student is not adversely affected by the difficulty level between the texts.

Dyslexia Reading Game uses strategies such as model reading + eye tracking, choral reading + eye tracking, repeated reading, performance feedback, goal setting, goal-oriented reading, graphical feedback and rewarding, which are widely used all over the world to support reading skills. The reading competition between users, on the other hand, allows four different users to challenge each other and organize a reading competition.
